data.action: 抱抱枕蜷缩在沙发上安稳沉睡
data.description: 【羽毛笔 · 休息室午憩】罗德岛干员休息室柔软的大沙发上，拉菲艾拉整个人蜷缩成一团，怀里紧紧抱着一只毛绒大抱枕安稳沉睡，头顶的羽毛随着均匀的呼吸轻轻起伏。宛如一只在安全巢穴里熟睡的幼鸟，让人忍不住想要轻抚她的头顶。
data.lighting: warm golden window sunlight, soft dust motes, gentle ambient fill
data.promptProse: La Pluma sleeps curled on the Rhodes Island lounge sofa, hugging a large fluffy cushion to her oversized pink hoodie. Her hair feather rests above the cushion in an intimate medium view. The sofa back encloses her resting shape, with the lounge wall farther behind. Golden afternoon window light grazes her feather and cushion fibers, leaving soft contact shadows between her arms and the upholstery.
data.title: 羽毛笔 · 休息室午憩
